method: Actual view_image inspection by reviewer, not reliance on D4 inspection testimony. Both source crops are rendered at native integer crop size on a white labeled canvas.
observations: NorthPark proposed ribbon is a horizontal pale rendered region next to a road and close to a dashed circle/sprite. The +12 control moves toward the road, retaining a real visible confound. Bright comparison lies in a tan sports-field patch. These remain proposed visual labels.

TowneLake proposed ribbon is the upper-left diagonal pale band between caller endpoints. The +12 control is parallel and shifted toward the edge/background. Bright comparison is open irregular grass/tree terrain lower-right. No independent terrain class is established.
All three overlays and training endpoints are visible; sources are not replaced by synthetic images. Unmasked texture, symbols and rings remain potential contamination.
